records.rationale: Both independent proposals identify conventional website-building capabilities (visual editor, templates, responsive design, publishing/hosting and SEO) on official IM Creator pages. Neither found credible AI evidence, but the pages do not comprehensively establish all included/optional functions or source-version history. Adopt non-AI provisionally with weak/forced status rather than treating absent AI terminology as dispositive; both proposals' weak support merits adjudication.

issues: Both negative judgments are weak; optional functionality and historical applicability not exhaustively documented.
